summary: GPGI, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada, effective June 5, 2026. Each share of Class A common stock automatically converted on a one-for-one basis into Nevada common stock, with no change in headquarters, business, management, assets, liabilities, or net worth. Stockholders need not exchange certificates. This is an administrative change of domicile, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, premium, or advisor named. No risk-arb angle; watch for any potential tax or litigation implications, but none are indicated.
